notes:
OCRelay 1.1.21

FASTER: VALUES APPEAR AS THEY ARE READ

• The review panel now fills in field by field while the AI reads the worksheet, instead of staying empty until every value is ready. Confirm unlocks once the whole worksheet has been read.

• OCRelay gets its connection to the AI ready while you are still drawing the capture box, so the read starts sooner.

NEW: AFI PERCENTILE FROM THE REFERENCE CHART

• OB Complete, OB Limited and BPP: when the worksheet gives an AFI and a gestational age but no percentile is marked, the AFI percentile is filled in from the AFI reference chart (16–42 weeks).

• When the tech did mark a percentile, it is checked against the chart. If they disagree, a red note above Confirm shows what the chart gives and outlines the AFI, gestational age and percentile, so you can see which one is wrong. The marked value is never changed for you; "Use chart range" puts the chart's range in.

FIX: WINDOWS STAY ON OCRELAY'S MONITOR

• The settings panel, the calibrator, the sign-in window, dropdown lists and every dialog now open on the monitor OCRelay is on, sized to that monitor — including a portrait monitor beside a landscape one.

• The settings panel opens above OCRelay when there is more room there, and refits when you drag OCRelay to another screen.
